references.text: Parallel account of Israel's victory over Og, king of Bashan, at Edrei. Moses recounts this event in Deuteronomy.
Reference to the victory over Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
Moses reminds the people of the victory over Og, king of Bashan, as part of God's mighty deeds.
Reference to how the Lord dealt with Og, king of Bashan, as a guarantee of future victory.
Mentions Og, king of Bashan, as one of the kings Israel defeated, with Ashtaroth and Edrei as his cities.
Describes Og's kingdom in Bashan, including Ashtaroth and Edrei.
Mentions Edrei as part of the area Israel conquered east of the Jordan.
Praises God for defeating Og, king of Bashan, as part of His mighty deeds.
Thanks the Lord who defeated Og, king of Bashan, for His mercy endures forever.
